answer: An agent marketplace requires each identity to lock $100 for 30 days before submitting up to ten bids daily. Agents can trade nebula images, sell mesa maps, or wander between tasks, but creating another name does not unlock free bidding capacity: every alias needs its own deposit. An attacker seeking 10,000 bids a day must immobilize $100,000, bearing the financing cost for a month even if none of the bids succeeds.
